content.title: Easter Dinner at Home & Easter Reservations | Founding Farmers
content.text: March 4, 2026 Events, Food Order Easter To Go Easter Brunch, Dinner & At-Home Meals at Founding Farmers Looking for Easter Eats & Treats? Celebrate Easter Weekend with us at home and in our restaurants with brunch, lunch, and dinner. Reserve a Table for Easter Brunch, Lunch, or Dinner Is Founding Farmers open on Easter? Yes – all of our locations are open Easter Sunday and we’d love to have you. Reserve a table for Easter online at any of our restaurants across the Washington, DC metro area and King of Prussia, PA, or, weather permitting, on one of our patios. Enjoy our Farmers Market Buffet Brunch or A La Carte Brunch, depending on location. (Check out our weekend brunch offerings.) You can also join us for a late lunch or spend your Easter dinner with us. Our full scratch-made lunch & dinner menus, with all of our everyday favorites, are available on Easter after brunch at all of our locations. Our Easter Sunday hours by location: Founding Farmers Foggy Bottom (DC): 8:30am–10pm Founding Farmers Georgetown (DC): 9am–9pm Founding Farmers Chinatown (DC): 9am–9pm Founding Farmers Montgomery County: 8:30am–9pm Founding Farmers Reston Station: 9am–9pm Founding Farmers Tysons Corner: 8am–10pm Founding Farmers Alexandria: 8am–10pm Founding Farmers King of Prussia: 8am–9pm Easter Brunch & Dinner To Go – Heat, Eat & Enjoy! – Ordering Closed Started in our scratch-made kitchens and ready to be finished in yours, our Easter Weekend at Home menu has everything you need for a delicious holiday spread. Choose from starters, entrées, desserts, chocolate, breakfast options for the whole family, and our new Holiday BBQ. Our Easter Weekend at Home menu is available for pick up at most* of our locations across DC, MD, VA, and PA, including Georgetown, Chinatown, Potomac, Reston Station, Tysons, Alexandria, and King of Prussia. Ordering now CLOSED! Pick up: Saturday, April 4 *Founding Farmers DC is NOT a Heat & Eat pick up location. Cancellations made after 12pm on March 31 will be subject to a 50% charge. For those who order Easter at Home, our reheating and light cooking instructions are linked here and included with all orders. BBQ For Easter? Yes, Please. Our scratch-made, house-smoked BBQ is back for the biggest spring gathering of the year. Our Thanksgiving and Christmas BBQ spreads were such a hit, we’re bringing them back for Easter, and whether you’re hosting dinner or showing up as the guest everyone’s glad they invited, this is the secret weapon that’ll have the whole table asking “Where did you get THIS?” Our meats meats arrive ready to reheat — just pop them in the oven or warm them on the stovetop following our simple instructions (reheat times range from 30 minutes to 3.5 hours), and you’re done. More time with family, less time in the kitchen. Pick your protein: St. Louis Sweet Heat Spare Ribs with Joe’s BBQ sauce Carolina Pulled Pork with Carolina gold mustard BBQ sauce Orange-Jalapeño Chicken with Joe’s BBQ sauce Half Brisket or Full Brisket Each selection serves 4 and comes with a hearty sampling of our crisp and crunchy fixin’s — pickled red onions, sliced sweet yellow onions, pickled cherry and banana peppers, and bread & butter pickles. Round out the spread with irresistible sides: Blue Ribbon Cowboy Baked Beans Braised Collard Greens & Cabbage Mustard Potato Salad Whiskey Creamed Corn with Masa Streusel It worked for Thanksgiving. It worked for Christmas. Make Easter the easiest (and tastiest) holiday yet. Choc’in Down the Bunny Trail with Founding Farmers Chocolate Gift some bunny you love Founding Farmers Chocolate! Our Easter Weekend at Home menu features our indulgent Chocolate Squares, Candy Bar Classics, and more. Our artisan, handcrafted chocolate is smooth & luscious and a great way to end your Easter feast. It’s also a fantastic way to treat yourself or your kiddos to Easter chocolate without all the artificial ingredients and fillers. Our Chocolate Bunny and chocolate eggs are back by popular demand. Surprise & delight in our filled Milk Chocolate Creme Egg, Milk Chocolate Virginia Peanut Butter Egg, and Dark Chocolate Founding Spirits Bourbon Caramel Egg. Want something festive and great for kiddos? Our Milk Chocolate Bunny is always a hit. Our Easter chocolates are available to order on our Easter at Home menu and in-store and online for pick up & delivery from March 18 through April 5 – or while supplies last! Easter Dining & At Home FAQs Is Founding Farmers open on Easter? Yes! All Founding Farmers locations are open on Easter Sunday, April 5. Hours vary by location — see our full Easter Sunday hours above. Does Founding Farmers have Easter brunch? Yes! We’re serving Easter brunch at all of our locations across DC, MD, VA, and PA on Easter Sunday, April 5. Depending on location, you can enjoy our Farmers Market Buffet Brunch or A La Carte Brunch. After brunch, our full scratch-made lunch and dinner menus are available at all locations. Reserve your table online. Can I order Easter brunch or dinner to go from Founding Farmers? Absolutely. Our Easter Weekend at Home menu is available for pick up at most of our DC, MD, VA, and PA locations (note: Founding Farmers in Foggy Bottom is not a Heat & Eat pick up location). Orders must be placed by Tuesday, March 31 at 12pm, with pick up on Saturday, April 4. What’s included in the Founding Farmers Easter at Home menu? Our Easter Weekend at Home menu includes starters, entrées, desserts, breakfast options, and our new Holiday BBQ — scratch-made and house-smoked meats that arrive ready to reheat. BBQ options include St. Louis Sweet Heat Spare Ribs, Carolina Pulled Pork, Orange-Jalapeño Chicken, and Half or Full Brisket, each serving 4 and accompanied by house-made fixin’s. Sides, chocolates, and more round out the spread. Does Founding Farmers have Easter chocolate or Easter baskets? We do! Our Easter chocolates include Milk Chocolate Creme Eggs, Milk Chocolate Virginia Peanut Butter Eggs, Dark Chocolate Founding Spirits Bourbon Caramel Eggs, and our popular Milk Chocolate Bunny. All are handcrafted with no artificial ingredients or fillers. Easter chocolates are available for pick up and delivery from March 18 through April 5, or while supplies last, and can be ordered through our Easter at Home menu or in-store and online. Where is Founding Farmers located? Founding Farmers has restaurant locations across the Washington, DC metro area — including Foggy Bottom (DC), Georgetown (DC), Chinatown (DC), Montgomery County, Tysons Corner, Reston Station, and Alexandria — as well as King of Prussia, PA. Most locations are available for Easter at Home pick up (excluding Founding Farmers Foggy Bottom). How do I reheat my Founding Farmers Easter at Home order? Step-by-step reheating and light cooking instructions are included with all orders. Reheat times range from 30 minutes to 3.5 hours depending on your selections, and everything is designed to be finished easily in your own kitchen. What is the cancellation policy for Easter at Home orders? Cancellations made after 12pm on March 31 will be subject to a 50% charge. Does Founding Farmers have a kids’ Easter option? While we don’t have a dedicated kids’ menu, there’s plenty for the whole family to love. Our Easter at Home menu includes breakfast options and chocolate perfect for families, including our Milk Chocolate Bunny and chocolate eggs. At locations offering our Farmers Market Buffet Brunch, little ones ages 3 and under eat free, and kids ages 4–12 are $18.50. Our restaurants are also a great spot to bring the whole family for Easter brunch.
